columns.label: G
columns.help: Games played within the selected filters.

columns.label: EPA/Carry
columns.help: EPA per carry. Expected points added: how much a play changed the offense's expected points, based on down, distance and field position before and after it.

columns.label: Success
columns.help: Success rate on carries. Share of plays that kept the offense on schedule: at least 50% of the yards to go on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th. Touchdowns always count; turnovers never do.

columns.label: Explosive Rate
columns.help: Share of carries that gained 10 yards or more.
